description: MemHub's Claude Code mod: the team Rulebook's lanes in-process (rules checked on each tool call, prompt and session, claimed from the Python command hooks only once the rule book is loaded, and handed back to them on any failure) and the companion above the prompt. The MemHub companion above the prompt: one animal a session (/goose, /hippo, /penguin, /shiba, and any other in animals/), picked from the session id unless one is pinned (`/<animal> always`; `random`, `never` and `include` shape the pick), asleep while idle, looking around while Claude answers or you type, up announcing each MemHub rule that fires — crossly when one blocks a call — and, whichever animal it is, hopping up with a new rule the harness proposed, asking Activate / Reject / Later on buttons inside its bubble (1, 2, 3). Clicking the ♥ beside it pets it, and a proposal's rule↗ opens that rule in MemHub Studio.
